sections.title: Celebrate *here*
sections.intro: Every package includes 1 hour 30 minutes in a party room, unlimited playtime afterwards, basic cutlery, a juice pouch per child, and set-up and clean-up. Bring any food and drinks you like. The birthday child gets grip socks.
sections.footnote: Time slots: 10:00–11:30, 12:00–1:30, 2:00–3:30, 4:00–5:30 and 6:00–7:30. A 50% non-refundable deposit reserves your space, and you must tour the party rooms before booking. Ask about slumber parties, after-hours events, characters, face painting and balloon decorations. Prices as listed on the current site.

items.a: Yes. Grip socks are required for everybody in the play area, adults included. They are available at PlayLand for $4.50 per pair.

items.q: Is there a charge for adults?
items.a: Two adults per group are free. Each additional adult is charged a $5.00 occupancy fee.
Yes. Parents have free range to play in every part of the facility. Please keep in mind that some equipment is designed for the little ones.

items.q: Can I leave my child unattended?
items.a: No. All children must be accompanied by a guardian or an adult.

items.q: Why do I need to fill out a waiver?
items.a: Waivers help keep you and your children safe, and in case of emergency we need your contact information. You can fill one out before you visit.
